title: User tiers appear in the dashboard
summary:
User tiers reached the dashboard and GPT Image routing, while an NVDA accessibility tool joined the community project list.

Added seed, flower, and nectar tiers. The dashboard now shows a user's tier, and the Special Bee form accepts flower-tier requests. Users without an assigned tier default to seed; this change does not add automatic upgrades or tier-based limits.

Authenticated GPT Image requests now route by tier rather than choosing an endpoint at random: seed users take one route, while flower and nectar users take another. Requests without tier information use seed routing.

The README and website now list AI Content Describer, an NVDA extension that uses multimodal AI to describe pictures, UI controls, and complex diagrams for blind and visually impaired Windows users.

highlights.title: See your user tier
highlights.text: The dashboard now shows your seed, flower, or nectar tier. You can request flower tier through the Special Bee form.
